rationale: Correct Evolve's predecessor identity, Stonepeak ownership chronology and current asset perimeter. Preserve the 2015 preferred investment, the 2020 transfer of GP control and the 2024 elimination of the public float without treating sold or dissolved projects as current assets.

supports: Stonepeak's $350 million preferred investment closed October 14, 2015
The investment was private equity rather than debt-only exposure
Stonepeak acquired GP control on September 7, 2020
The 2024 limited call eliminated the unaffiliated public float
Stonepeak continues to list Evolve as a current investment
Evolve remains an operating U.S. midstream platform

beforeImage.name: Evolve Transition Infrastructure LP
beforeImage.subsector: Energy transition infrastructure and lower-carbon fuels assets
beforeImage.description: Evolve Transition Infrastructure LP is a Houston-based partnership focused on infrastructure that supports the lower-carbon energy transition. Its assets and development activities span natural gas gathering and processing, pipelines, and renewable fuels-related infrastructure, serving industrial and energy counterparties rather than retail customers. The platform combines owned midstream assets with development-stage projects, resulting in a mix of contracted infrastructure exposure and project execution risk. Stonepeak's investment materials describe South Texas natural gas infrastructure and renewable fuels partnerships as part of the company's operating footprint. Stonepeak has backed the platform since at least 2021, but the current ownership percentage is not publicly disclosed.

milestones.event: Evolve Transition Infrastructure LP was founded.
Stonepeak invested in the gathering system acquisition from Sanchez Energy for $346 million.
Evolve and Stonepeak announced the Levo joint venture to pursue electric fleet infrastructure.
Evolve and HOBO Renewable Diesel announced an agreement to develop renewable fuels projects.

afterImage.name: Evolve Transition Infrastructure LP
afterImage.subsector: Natural gas gathering, processing and transportation
afterImage.description: Evolve Transition Infrastructure LP is a private, Stonepeak-controlled U.S. midstream platform whose current disclosed operating perimeter comprises the Catarina gathering system and the Seco pipeline in South Texas. Stonepeak entered through a $350 million private preferred-equity investment in 2015, acquired general-partner control on September 7, 2020 and obtained all remaining economic interests when the unaffiliated public float was cashed out on February 16, 2024. Carnero, HOBO and Levo are former, terminated or dissolved investments and are not current Evolve assets.
